images.title: The climb through the rocks
images.caption: Oates’s Alabama infantry climbs through broken ground. The slope helps explain why a simple wheel was hard to execute.
images.prompt: Create a single photorealistic, landscape-format historical reenactment still. Natural color as if professionally photographed on location; human, restrained, materially credible, candid composition. No captions, letters, maps, labels, watermark, collage or painted surface. July 2 1863, Little Round Top, Pennsylvania. Eye-level looking obliquely across a steep oak-covered rocky slope. Mid-distance from the side, several files of tired 15th Alabama infantry in grey and muted brown short wool jackets, mixed felt hats, 1860s percussion rifle muskets, moving UPHILL in loose alignment, clambering around large granite boulders. Summer green canopy; warm afternoon, no summit monuments, roads or flags.
